calls.title: Brian Wang and Jake Heier
calls.summary: Brian Wang (product/tech lead), Kevin Dyer (principal data engineer), Meridy Boyd-Clark (mobile product owner), and James (mobile lead engineer) discussed replacing their in-house A/B testing and feature flagging tools with Growthbook to address pain points like slow, manual data analysis and fragmented tracking across web and mobile apps. The key next steps are an internal kickoff next week to define a search refinement test candidate, setting up a Slack channel for support, and scheduling tailored sessions with Growthbook's data science and product teams for best practices and a live walkthrough.

calls.title: Brian Wang and Jake Heier
calls.summary: The call focused on setting up GrowthBook for an A/B test on a property map search feature at Trade Me. Key participants included Brian Wang (organizer), Luke Sonnet (GrowthBook Head of Experiments) who explained feature flags, experiment setup, and data source configuration, and Michael Evans (product owner) who raised concerns about autonomy. Next steps are to connect Snowflake, create the necessary identifier and metric tables, set up the experiment, and validate via Slack, with the goal of launching next week.
